title: OneBlock CraftBound: Classic
description: A custom NeoForge OneBlock mod with phases, rewards, chests, mobs, and a true one-block start.
body:
# CraftBound OneBlock

**CraftBound OneBlock** is a custom OneBlock mod for **Minecraft NeoForge 1.21.1**.

Start on a single block in the void and break it to progress through long-form phases. The mod includes a true one-block start, phase-based block progression, milestone reward chests, random chest events, animal and monster events, item recovery around the OneBlock, and a custom CraftBound OneBlock world preset.

## Features

* True one-block start
* Custom CraftBound OneBlock world preset
* CraftBound OneBlock selected by default when creating a new world
* Long-form phase progression
* Milestone reward chests
* Water bucket reward at 100 blocks
* Lava bucket reward at 1000 blocks
* Random phase-based chest events
* Phase-based animal and monster events
* Item recovery around the OneBlock to help prevent drops from falling into the void
* Subtle particles above the active OneBlock
* Styled welcome title and chat message
* Singleplayer-focused beta gameplay

## Commands

* `/oneblock stats` — shows your current progress
* `/oneblock phase` — shows the current phase
* `/oneblock create` — creates a OneBlock setup manually
* `/oneblock set` — manually sets the OneBlock position
* `/oneblock reset` — resets OneBlock progress
* `/oneblock debug` — testing commands for operators

## Beta Notice

This is an early beta release. Bugs, balancing issues, and progression changes are expected.

Singleplayer testing is recommended first.
